description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a 2D Designer based in Switzerland. Join a creative, community-driven digital environment where immersive social experiences, virtual worlds, and user-generated content come together. As a 2D Designer, you will create polished, engaging visuals across storefronts, marketing campaigns, in-app promotions, and virtual environments. Your work will help showcase digital products, strengthen visual storytelling, and enhance the experience of users exploring a vibrant social VR platform. You will design everything from product thumbnails and promotional banners to social media graphics, event signage, and in-world textures. The role requires a versatile creative approach, combining strong visual design skills with an understanding of how graphics perform across different sizes, formats, and interfaces. Working collaboratively with a distributed team, you will respond to feedback, adapt to evolving priorities, and deliver high-quality assets within established brand guidelines. This is an excellent opportunity for a resourceful designer who enjoys variety, values attention to detail, and wants to contribute to a growing digital community through impactful visual communication. Accountabilities Storefront design: Create compelling thumbnails and graphics for digital store listings, ensuring products are visually appealing, easy to understand, and recognizable at small sizes. Bundle graphics and visual identity: Design promotional graphics for product bundles, clearly communicating included items while maintaining strong visual appeal. Develop distinct themes for each bundle, including backgrounds, navigation icons, and mobile-friendly variations that remain consistent with the overall storefront identity. Marketing and promotional assets: Produce engaging social media posts, announcement graphics, blog headers, and other marketing materials that support campaigns, product updates, and community initiatives. Video graphics: Design static visual assets for video content, including title cards, overlays, and end screens, ensuring consistency with established branding and communication objectives. Platform-specific creative production: Prepare and export graphics for distribution platforms such as Steam and Meta, adapting each asset to the relevant dimensions, file formats, and technical specifications. In-app visual design: Create banners for events and promotions, notification graphics, and other in-app visuals that integrate naturally with the user interface and remain legible at smaller display sizes. In-world artwork: Develop signage, posters, textures, and other 2D assets used within virtual worlds, helping create visually engaging and immersive user experiences. Brand consistency and creative execution: Work within established visual guidelines while giving individual assets their own distinctive character, ensuring a cohesive yet varied visual identity across different touchpoints. Multi-format adaptation: Optimize designs for different screen sizes, layouts, and contexts, including mobile devices, storefronts, social channels, and in-app interfaces. Feedback and iteration: Collaborate with stakeholders, incorporate feedback efficiently, and refine designs through quick review cycles while adapting to changing priorities and deadlines. Asset organization and delivery: Maintain clean, well-organized working files, consistent naming conventions, and properly layered source documents to support efficient collaboration and future updates. Requirements A strong portfolio demonstrating a range of 2D design work, ideally including marketing graphics, user interface assets, storefront visuals, or digital product promotions. Proven experience creating graphics for multiple formats and display sizes, particularly thumbnails, icons, banners, and mobile layouts. Strong proficiency in industry-standard design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Figma, or comparable creative software. A solid understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, composition, color, and branding, with the ability to create polished, high-impact graphics for different audiences and contexts. Experience working within an existing brand identity while developing creative variations that give individual campaigns, products, or collections a distinctive look. Familiarity with preparing and exporting assets according to platform-specific technical requirements, including file formats, dimensions, and resolution specifications. The ability to design for small-scale displays, ensuring that graphics remain clear, legible, and visually effective when viewed within compact interfaces. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to understand creative briefs, respond constructively to feedback, and work through rapid revision cycles. Flexibility and adaptability when managing changing priorities, multiple types of creative deliverables, and short turnaround times. Excellent file management practices, including organized project folders, consistent naming conventions, and properly layered, editable source files. A detail-oriented approach and a commitment to maintaining high visual quality and consistency across all deliverables. The ability to work independently in a remote environment while coordinating effectively with a distributed creative team. Nice to have Familiarity with social VR platforms, virtual communities, or user-generated virtual environments. Experience creating textures or other 2D assets for real-time 3D applications, particularly projects built with Unity. An understanding of how visual assets contribute to digital storefront conversion, community engagement, and immersive user experiences. Experience supporting digital product launches, online campaigns, or event-based promotional activities. Benefits Fully remote work: Work remotely from Anywhere, with flexibility to organize your work within agreed project timelines and deliverables. Part-time engagement: A contract opportunity suited to a designer seeking a flexible, project-based workload. Creative variety: Work across storefront graphics, marketing campaigns, social media, in-app promotions, and virtual-world artwork. Portfolio development: Build a diverse body of work spanning digital product design, marketing communication, interface graphics, and immersive environments. Creative ownership: Contribute original ideas and distinctive visual treatments while working within an established brand identity. Collaborative environment: Work with a creative, distributed team that values collaboration, feedback, and contributions from different perspectives. Fast-paced creative experience: Develop your ability to deliver polished assets through iterative design processes and changing project priorities. Exposure to social VR: Gain experience creating visual assets for a platform centered on virtual worlds, digital communities, and user-generated experiences. Flexible contract arrangement: Provide your weekly availability and proposed hourly rate as part of your application. Inclusive workplace culture: Join an equal-opportunity environment that welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds and encourages creative participation. Additional application information Contract duration: The assignment is expected to run through the end of the year. Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an Account Manager, Client Development & Renewals, you will own a book of existing customer accounts and drive both renewal retention and expansion revenue within them. This is a growth-first role where renewal is the floor, not the goal: you will protect the base by keeping renewals healthy and on time, and grow it by uncovering whitespace, running consultative upsell and cross-sell conversations, and turning satisfied customers into expanding ones. Working closely with Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and Sales Engineers, you will build account plans and get ahead of risk before it reaches the forecast. If you are driven to outgrow a base you know well, own your numbers, and earn a path to strategic accounts or AE-track roles through expansion results, this role is for you.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own a portfolio of existing accounts carrying a dual quota of renewal retention and expansion bookings, identifying whitespace across the SentinelOne portfolio and leading consultative upsell and cross-sell conversations built around customer use cases and outcomes rather than just quotes.
  • Spot expansion triggers early, such as new use cases, organizational growth, underutilized licenses, and competitive displacement openings, and build repeatable account plans with your CSM and SE partners that map multi-year growth rather than just the next renewal.
  • Manage renewals end to end, from early quoting and multi-threading through negotiation and on-time close, handling commercial negotiations including multi-year commitments and keeping timelines definitive and forecasts predictable across your book.
  • Identify churn and downgrade risk early by monitoring deployment health, usage, support signals, and sentiment, running save motions on at-risk accounts with CSM, Support, and leadership, and getting ahead of overdeployment and downgrade exposure before it hits the renewal.
  • Own an accurate, transparent forecast across renewal and expansion pipeline, keep Salesforce and CPQ tools current, and partner with CSMs, AEs, SEs, and Channel/MSSP partners on account coverage and growth while bringing the customer’s voice back to Product and the broader team.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 3–5 years in renewals, account management, or a customer-facing sales role with upsell and cross-sell closing experience, ideally in SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • A track record of hitting or beating quota, including driving net revenue retention above 100% on your own book, with expansion outpacing churn rather than renewal completion alone.
  • Proven experience running consultative upsell and cross-sell motions, identifying and closing whitespace within an existing customer base, and negotiating confidently with senior and economic buyers across multi-stakeholder conversations.
  • A risk-aware instinct for spotting early signals of churn or downgrade, combined with strong forecasting discipline, CRM hygiene, and hands-on experience with Salesforce and CPQ or quoting tools.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, curiosity about customer use cases and the product, and a habit of opening expansion conversations unprompted, with comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Exposure to Channel/MSSP or 2-tier GTM models is a plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

description: We’re Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again. We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years. To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund. If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in. The role We are hiring a Clinical Trials Lead to own the commercial work that follows. You will develop Heidi’s view of the market, identify the strongest entry point, build senior relationships across the industry, secure early customers and shape a repeatable route to market. Your knowledge of clinical trials will inform and shape what Heidi builds. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who operates like a founder. You will make the calls, open the doors, write the proposal, run the meeting and stay accountable after the contract is signed. As the business proves itself, the role can grow into broader ownership of Heidi’s clinical trials business. What you’ll do Develop the market thesis. Map the clinical trials ecosystem, test the most valuable opportunities and recommend where Heidi should focus its time and capital. Lead customer development. Build direct relationships with senior decision makers across sponsors, biotechnology companies, CROs, sites and health systems. Conduct the outreach yourself and turn conversations into qualified opportunities. Own early commercial outcomes. Build the pipeline, secure design partners and paid programmes, and own early revenue. Define the measures that show whether the business is gaining traction. Shape the proposition. Turn buyer needs into a clear commercial offer, including target customer, value proposition, pricing, packaging and proof of value. Inform what Heidi builds. Bring evidence from customers and clinical trials workflows to the product lead. Help the team choose problems worth solving while the product lead retains ownership of product strategy and delivery. Navigate the buying process. Understand how life sciences organisations evaluate vendors, allocate budgets, manage procurement and compliance, and move from pilot to broader deployment. Build the delivery model. Work with product, engineering, clinical, legal and implementation colleagues to make early programmes successful and increasingly repeatable. Create the route to scale. Determine which partnerships, channels, proof points and team capabilities are required to grow beyond founder-led selling. Represent Heidi. Build Heidi’s credibility with customers, partners and industry networks through thoughtful engagement and useful domain expertise. What you’ll need The strongest candidates will combine deep clinical trials knowledge with a record of creating commercial value. We expect the following experience. Deep experience in the clinical trials industry through a pharmaceutical or biotechnology company, CRO, trial technology business, research network or closely related organisation. A strong understanding of how clinical trials are funded, sold, bought and delivered, including the incentives and constraints faced by sponsors, CROs and research sites. A record of building revenue, partnerships, a business line or a company in the sector. You can show what you personally originated and how it performed. Senior commercial credibility. You can open a conversation with an industry executive, diagnose the underlying business problem and move the relationship towards a concrete commitment. The judgement to operate in a regulated environment while respecting Good Clinical Practice, patient consent, privacy and data integrity. The independence to create structure, make decisions and produce results without an established playbook or a large supporting team. Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects. You default to building over requesting. You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them. How we show up Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism. Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that. Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford. Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander. Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless. Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it. Why Heidi? You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver. Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally. We take care of you. description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Compliance team’s mission is to keep iwoca a safe and trusted lender for UK small businesses, and to make the compliant path the easy path for the teams we work with. We make sure iwoca meets its regulatory obligations, particularly the financial crime, sanctions and data protection requirements that apply across our suite of products and services. We are the second line of defence for the UK business. We advise the people building and running the business on what the rules require, set the policies and standards they work to, and test whether what happens in practice matches them. We work alongside the product teams so that each product meets its obligations and can grow. Data protection is central to what we do. We hold the data privacy function for the UK business and own how iwoca handles personal data end to end: the lawful basis for how customer, applicant and third-party data is used; data subject access requests and other individual rights; personal data breaches; retention and deletion; records of processing; marketing and consent; the privacy review of new products and features; and the governance of automated decisioning and AI tooling. How we work: We enable rather than block. The answer is rarely just “no” — it’s what it would take to get to yes, and what the firm is accepting if it goes ahead anyway. We go to the source. Positions are grounded in the actual rule, regulation or guidance, and we can show where they come from. We’re proportionate. Controls match the risk in front of us. We don’t build process for its own sake. We’re close to the business. We work directly with Tech, Data, Credit, Operations and Legal, and we want to be in the room early rather than at the end. The role As Data Privacy Analyst you will run iwoca’s day-to-day UK data protection work and help the business apply UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and PECR in practice. Your primary focus will be the statutory core: data subject access requests, data protection impact assessments, legitimate interests assessments, personal data breaches and records of processing. The role is not only to run that work but to improve it. A significant part of the job is identifying where our privacy operations could be automated, supported by AI or otherwise improved, assessing what each option would take and what it would mean for compliance, and specifying it well enough for our Tech and Data teams to deliver. There is real room for the role to grow: as you build credibility, so does the scope, towards owning areas of the framework outright, leading on AI and automation governance, and taking a larger advisory remit across the business. You will report to the Data Privacy Manager and work closely with the Head of Compliance who also acts as iwoca’s DPO, so you will have experienced support on the harder judgement calls. This is a hands-on role and the work is visible — much of it goes to senior stakeholders or to the regulator. Impact and influence Individual rights and data breaches. Own data subject access requests from intake to response — scoping the search, applying exemptions and meeting the statutory deadline — along with erasure, rectification and objection requests. Triage and investigate suspected personal data breaches, assess them against the 72-hour notification test, and keep the breach register accurate. Privacy assessments and advice. Assist with DPIAs, legitimate interests assessments and other privacy reviews on new products, features, suppliers and data flows. Be an accessible first point of contact for teams across iwoca with a data protection question, and give them an answer they can act on, early enough to shape what they build. Records, policies and reporting. Keep the record of processing activities accurate as the business changes, hold the retention and deletion schedules to account, review data processing agreements with suppliers, help maintain our data protection policies and standards, and produce the privacy reporting that goes to senior stakeholders. AI and automated decisioning. Help assess AI tooling and automated decision-making across lending and operations: what personal data goes in, what lawful basis supports it, what the model does with it, and what rights customers have over the outcome. That includes the risks specific to these systems — decisions taken without meaningful human involvement, bias in outcomes, unreliable model output — and recommending how we address them. Automation and improvement. Identify the manual steps in our privacy operations that should not be manual, assess the options, and set out the requirements and compliance implications clearly enough for Tech and Data to deliver them. The requirements Essential skills Experience. Experience in data protection or privacy operations, or in a compliance, legal, risk or operational role where data protection was a real part of the job. Data protection knowledge. A solid practical understanding of UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and PECR, and of how the ICO expects firms to apply them. Familiarity with the changes made by the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 is an advantage. Privacy operations and assessments. Hands-on experience of statutory work: DSARs, DPIAs, legitimate interests assessments, breach handling, ROPA maintenance or data processing agreement review. You may not have done all of these — but we want to see that you have done some of them properly. AI and automation. A real interest in, and working understanding of, how data protection law applies to AI and automated decision-making. Enough technical fluency to see where a manual process could be automated, set out what is needed, and hold your own in a conversation with engineers. Stakeholder management: Comfortable dealing directly with product, engineering, marketing, credit and operations teams, and able to give a non-specialist a clear answer they can act on rather than a legal summary. Bonus: Sector experience. Financial services or fintech, ideally in lending or payments. Credentials. A privacy or AI qualification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, or ICO-recognised practitioner certificates — or working towards one. Practical tooling. Experience using Claude Code, LLMs or privacy management platforms. The culture At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.   • Analyser les données financières et élaborer des modèles de valorisation financière.

description: Location: Remote in Europe About Nivoda 🚀 Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise. Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry. Our Mission 🎯 Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them. About the Role 🤔 Conversion is one of the three chokepoints in our revenue organisation. Customers arrive, take the demo, go through KYC, and too many stall before the first purchase, or buy once and never come back. The second purchase is where the product becomes sticky, and getting a merchant there is the hardest 60 days of their life with us. Fixing that takes two things, and this role owns both. Reps who know the product, the pricing and the playbook cold. And a conversion funnel that is measured, scored and coached rather than hoped for. Function one: enablement Training and standards Make sure every rep is up to spec and trained, and keep them there. Own the theoretical onboarding of every new rep, SDR, AE and AM alike: what Nivoda sells, to whom, at what price, and how. Set what "up to spec" means for each role and hold the bar. Documentation and materials Own the product material for every line of business: how it works, who it is for, pricing, take rate and best practice. Keep it current. A rep should never be the last person to find out something changed. The channel to marketing Act as the link between marketing and the front line. Every campaign is known to the reps in advance, socialised at the all-hands before it lands, not discovered from a customer. The channel to product Translate the product roadmap into enablement. You do not decide the roadmap. You turn it into what to sell, to whom, and when. When something ships, the reps already know what it is and how to position it. Function two: conversion Conversion rests on two things, and this role owns both: the call, and the KYC. A brilliant call that dies in KYC converts nothing, and a clean KYC on a badly run call never gets there. Call scoring Build the scoring rubrics with the team managers, so the standard is one both sides recognise. Run transcript review and scoring at volume, using Claude to do it. Send the reports out every week, to everyone. Run a weekly leaderboard: the best calls, the scores, winners and losers, visible to the team. Build a personalised coaching plan for every rep, written down and tracked, not delivered verbally and forgotten. Coach in two directions: with the managers so they can coach their own people, and directly with reps where that is faster. description: Ben jij het zonnetje in huis? En heb jij al affiniteit met de wereld van bedrijfsovernames? Lees dan vooral verder! Wij zoeken namelijk een junior adviseur bedrijfsovernames. Je bent - samen met een senior collega - verantwoordelijk voor het gehele overnameproces van MKB bedrijven. Wat is je takenpakket? Je stelt anonieme overname profielen en informatiememoranda op en controleert ze Je spreekt met geïnteresseerden, nadat deze door je collega’s gekwalificeerd zijn Je voert onderhandelingsgesprekken met geïnteresseerden Je maakt de deal en het begeleidt het LOI-proces Je onderhoud korte lijnen met jouw klant (de ondernemer die zijn bedrijf gaat verkopen). Die voelt dat jij aan z’n kant staat. We hebben specialisten op elk gebied van het bedrijfsovernameproces; waardebepalingen, juridische afwikkeling en het informeren van geïnteresseerden. Dit is dus allemaal al geregeld en hoeft dus niet alles zelf te doen. Ondanks dat dit niet bij jouw verantwoordelijkheden hoort, krijg je hier wel alles van mee. We werken namelijk als een team. Mocht je ervaring en interesse hier liggen, dan kunnen we je takenpakket hiermee uitbreiden. Wie is onze ideale kandidaat? Je hebt affiniteit met overname processen Je communiceert op een natuurlijke en informele wijze met diverse partijen Je hebt affiniteit hebt met cijfers en je kunt uit de voeten met jaarrekeningen en financiële rapportages Je vind het leuk jezelf te verplaatsen in MKB ondernemers uit diverse sectoren en van allerlei niveau’s Je hebt overredingskracht en geeft tegengas aan je klant wanneer het nodig is Je hebt een winnaarsmentaliteit en gaat daarvoor graag “the extra mile” Je kunt gemakkelijk tussen cases schakelen: bij een fulltime dienstverband werk je doorgaans aan 10-15 cases tegelijkertijd Over Take 5 Over het algemeen zijn ondernemers ongeduldige mensen. Het liefst is alles gisteren al gebeurd. Wij kennen het overnameproces. We zijn hierin deskundig en ervaren. Dat wil zeggen: we hebben alle expertise in huis om een MKB’er zo goed mogelijk mee te nemen en we doen dit al een hele tijd. Het verkopen van een bedrijf doen MKB ondernemers maximaal 1-2 keer in hun leven. Ze staan hun kindje af. Dit is een emotioneel en spannend proces. Wij zijn toegewijd en pro-actief. We zijn streng op de kwalificatie en nemen alleen genoegen met het beste voor de ondernemer. We zijn authentiek en gelijkwaardig. Dat wil zeggen: we gaan naast een ondernemer staan en nemen die stap voor stap mee. We gebruiken ons karakter en eigenaardigheden om de connectie met de ondernemer te maken. Hoe lekkerder je zelf in je vel zit, hoe beter je iemand kunt helpen. Wat wij je bieden Een hecht team waar jouw werk direct zichtbaar impact heeft Een omgeving waar keihard werken en keihard lachen hand in hand gaat De ruimte om te mogen zijn wie je bent Veel verantwoordelijkheid en geen hiërarchisch gedoe Ruimte om te groeien in wat je nog niet kan maar wel wil leren Een werkomgeving waar ‘doen waar je energie van krijgt’ het aller-belangrijkste is Salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden, daar komen we uit Belangrijk om te weten: voor deze functie zoeken we iemand die in loondienst komt. Daar tegenover staat dat je alle verantwoordelijkheden en voordelen krijgt die horen bij ondernemerschap. In de kern hebben wij geen programma om mede-eigenaar te worden. Mochten we er samen, na jarenlange gebleken geschiktheid, achter komen dat dit wel de juiste koers is, dan kan het alsnog. Dit is echter niet het initiële doel bij indiensttreding. description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. About The Exploration Company At The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital space vehicle that aims to eventually be refuelled in orbit, carrying cargo and potentially humans in the long run. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engine, which is why we develop our own propulsion systems, aiming for the highest level of efficiency and reliability. Role Summary We are seeking a Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer to join the engine control and monitoring team of Storm, our high-thrust LOX/LCH4 cryogenic rocket engine. Working alongside senior control engineers, you will develop and test control and monitoring algorithms, work with the engine functional models provided by the functional team, contribute to setting up the controller development environment, and help verify the controller through Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop testing and during engine test campaigns. This is an entry-level, hands-on role for a recent graduate with strong control fundamentals who wants to learn on real hardware and progressively grow into full ownership of safety-critical engine control functions. Key responsibilities: 1. Control & Monitoring Algorithm Development • Design and implement engine control and monitoring algorithms, following the software team's rules, guidelines and auto-coding practices. • Contribute to the definition of the engine regulation strategy (thrust and mixture ratio control, chill-down, start-up and shutdown transients) together with functional and system engineers. • Support the definition of control and monitoring requirements for engine subsystems (valves, pumps, sensors, controller, software). 2. Simulation & Controller Development Environment • Contribute to setting up the controller development environment: toolchain, model and code configuration management, auto-coding chain, and the MiL/SiL/HiL simulation and test infrastructure. • Integrate the engine functional models delivered by the functional team (turbopumps, valves, combustion devices, cryogenic feed lines; steady-state, transient and chill-down) into the control design and simulation environment, deriving simplified or linearised models for controller synthesis where needed. • Run closed-loop simulations to assess controller performance, stability margins and robustness to model uncertainties. • Feed test results back to the functional team to support model correlation, and flag model limitations that matter for control. 3. Health Monitoring & Fault Management • Contribute to the engine monitoring strategy that assesses the health status of the engine and its subsystems (combustion chamber, turbopumps, valves…). • Implement fault detection and sensor validation logic for both real-time protection and post-test analysis. • Support failure mode analyses (FMEA) and the management of failure modes, paving the way for engine reusability. 4. Validation, Testing & Documentation • Prepare and run Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop (MiL, SiL, HiL) test campaigns to verify the control and monitoring functions at each step, from Simulink model to embedded code on target hardware. • Support Storm engine and component cryogenic (LOX/LCH4) test campaigns: test preparation, on-site support, data processing and post-test analysis. • Produce clear development documentation: specifications, test procedures, test reports and justification files. What we would love to see from you: • Master's degree (or equivalent) in Aerospace, Electrical, Control or Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. • Recent graduate (or graduating within the next months); no professional experience required. A master's thesis, internship or academic project in control, propulsion or embedded systems is a strong plus. • Solid fundamentals in control theory, both classical and modern (state-space, robustness, digital control). • Practical use of MATLAB/Simulink and Python through coursework or projects; basic knowledge of C/C++. • Basic understanding of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics, and a strong interest in cryogenic propulsion and turbomachinery. • Fluent in English. Nice to Have: • Exposure to MiL/SiL/HiL testing or real-time embedded systems. • Experience with auto-coding from Simulink models. • Familiarity with safety-critical design practices, reliability engineering or failure mode analysis. • Interest or experience in data science applied to health monitoring and anomaly detection. • Knowledge of space standards (ECSS, MIL-STD, NASA-HBK…). • German and/or French. Skills & Behaviours: • Eagerness to learn and to take on increasing ownership under the guidance of senior engineers. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to draw useful conclusions from partial or contradictory data. • Clear oral and written communication; comfortable working closely with engine, avionics, software and test teams. • Organised, able to prioritise tasks and deliver within time constraints. • Positive, flexible attitude and enthusiasm for space exploration. • Behaviour consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork. description: Description QuantumDiamonds is building the world's first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. Our labs are where new ideas are turned into working quantum sensing systems — and you are the person who keeps those systems running. As our Lab Technician, you will join our Pre-Development Department and work hands-on with lasers, optics, RF electronics, precision mechanics, and the diamond quantum sensors at the heart of our widefield Quantum Diamond Microscope systems. You will take ownership of day-to-day lab operations: preparing and aligning experimental setups, running measurements, troubleshooting equipment, and making sure everything is precise, clean, and reproducible. Physicists and engineers will rely on your work every single day. You do not need a background in quantum physics. If you enjoy hands-on technical work, have an eye for detail, and are curious about how things work, we will teach you everything you need to know about our systems. What matters to us is craftsmanship, reliability, and the drive to make things work. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join QuantumDiamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Prepare our systems for new measurement series by reconfiguring and aligning experimental setups, installing samples and sensors, and setting the right parameters with a high level of precision and cleanliness. Run measurements such as fluorescence imaging and magnetic field scans alongside our physicists and engineers - taking on more independence as you get to know our systems. Evaluate and document measurement data and observations carefully, making sure results are traceable, reproducible, and ready for the team to build on. Take ownership of day-to-day lab operations: keep optical tables, lasers, microscopes, and RF electronics calibrated and ready to use, while keeping our labs safe, organized, and well stocked. Troubleshoot technical issues, spot things that could work better, and help us continuously improve our lab setups and procedures. What is expected of you A technical background or equivalent hands-on experience. This could be training as a Physiklaborant:in, Mechatroniker:in, CTA/PTA, PhyTA, staatlich geprüfte:r Techniker:in / Bachelor Professional in Mechatronics or Electrical Engineering — but we are also happy to hear from career changers with strong practical technical skills. You enjoy hands-on technical work and have a strong eye for detail, precision, and cleanliness. You are comfortable working with common lab and electrical equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies. You document your work carefully and can make sense of basic measurement data so others can reliably build on your results. You are proactive, reliable, and comfortable working in a dynamic R&D environment. You can communicate in English or German. Our working language is English, but you do not need to be fluent – being willing to use and improve it day to day is enough. Nice to have: Experience in an R&D, prototyping, or instrument-building environment. Skills in soldering, precision mechanics, vacuum technology, 3D printing, or basic CAD. Hands-on experience with optics, lasers, or photonics, or a laser safety qualification. Familiarity with basic data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Python, or Origin). Our benefits Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active. Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired. Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills. Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together. About us QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act. description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Fanatics Licensing Management (FLM) International is a leading in-house licensing agency managing a diverse portfolio of rights holders across global football, multi-sport properties, entertainment, and lifestyle brands. As Licensing Director, you will own and grow a portfolio of client licensing programmes from strategy to execution, operating as the senior point of accountability across commercial, creative, and operational dimensions — spanning IP positioning, category architecture, licensee recruitment, deal structuring, digital product strategy, and P&L ownership. The Licensing Director, FLM International delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Operations to deliver seamless client service across FLM's portfolio, ensuring commercial objectives are translated into aligned execution
  • Represent FLM at major licensing trade shows — including Licensing Expo, BLE, and LIMA events — and contribute to the new business pipeline by providing market insight and supporting pitches for prospective rights holders

People Leadership:

  • Line-manage and develop a team of licensing managers and executives, setting clear performance expectations and providing structured coaching and career development
  • Communicate portfolio strategy clearly to your team, ensuring execution is consistently aligned to commercial objectives and client commitments

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor to senior rights holder executives, building long-term trusted partnerships and translating brand objectives into actionable licensing programmes with clear KPIs
  • Lead annual business planning with clients across sports properties, federations, leagues, clubs, and entertainment brands, ensuring programmes are tailored to audience profile and commercial opportunity
  • Maintain high-quality relationships with licensees across your portfolio, resolving issues proactively, ensuring contractual compliance, and conducting regular business reviews to assess and accelerate performance
  • Collaborate with clients to build cohesive physical-to-digital licensing strategies that reinforce brand consistency and deepen fan engagement across channels

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

  • Lead licensing strategy for digital and emerging categories including gaming integrations, licensed digital content, and social commerce, advising clients on platform prioritisation and new partnership opportunities
  • Identify and pursue white-space opportunities within existing portfolios — new categories, geographies, and distribution channels — bringing fresh commercial thinking to each property
  • Track market trends including DTC licensing, digital collectibles, and brand collaborations, and proactively introduce relevant innovation to client programmes
  • Evaluate new platforms and partnerships — retail apps, streaming integrations, social commerce — and build recommendations that position FLM clients at the forefront of the licensing landscape

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

  • Own the licensing strategy and P&L across your assigned client portfolio, defining category architecture, market positioning, and revenue roadmaps tailored to each property's commercial opportunity
  • Drive licensee recruitment across all categories — including core product, digital goods, gaming, and experiential — and lead deal negotiations from term sheet to execution, working with Legal on contract structure, guarantees, royalty rates, and audit provisions
  • Oversee royalty reporting cycles in partnership with Finance, flagging anomalies and ensuring accurate P&L tracking across your portfolio
  • Partner with the approvals team to uphold brand standards across product development pipelines, ensuring licensee output consistently meets the quality and integrity expectations of each rights holder

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

  • Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
  • Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
  • Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in licensing, with at least 3 years in a senior client-facing or management role, including demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-property licensing programmes
  • Sharp commercial instinct with hands-on P&L ownership experience and a proven track record of driving revenue growth across diverse brand portfolios
  • Experience across both sports and lifestyle or entertainment licensing, with deep understanding of global licensing markets, category dynamics, and retail distribution
  • Confident negotiator comfortable with complex, multi-territory deal structures, including experience working with Legal on guarantees, royalty rates, and audit provisions
  • Proven people leader with a track record of developing talent, building high-performing teams, and operating effectively across cross-functional stakeholder environments
  • Familiarity with digital licensing, gaming, and emerging product categories, including DTC licensing, social commerce, and digital collectibles
  • Willingness to travel internationally for client meetings, licensing trade shows, and licensee visits

Education:

Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred.

WORK LOCATION

Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Paris, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence3 days per week. 

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

ABOUT US
Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, www.fanatics.com.

Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).

description:
Help protect what truly matters in our customers' most critical environments by proactively identifying threats and improving how they are detected and addressed.

As a Mission Critical Security Engineer with a focus on Threat Hunting, you will be part of a dedicated customer team responsible for securing and continuously improving a complex, mission-critical application landscape.

Working alongside other engineers and security specialists, you will help ensure the environment remains as secure and resilient as possible. You combine a strong engineering foundation with a security mindset, taking ownership of security improvements and understanding how systems, applications, and infrastructure behave.

Your specific focus will be on threat hunting and detection engineering. Using your in-depth knowledge of the customer's technology stack and application landscape, you will fine-tune existing detection use cases and develop new ones tailored to the environment. You will use our custom SIEM/SOAR-based Managed Detection and Response (MDR) platform to turn emerging threats and technical insights into actionable detection capabilities.

This role bridges security engineering, detection engineering, and threat intelligence. You don't simply follow predefined playbooks. You understand system behavior, identify gaps, and develop practical solutions that strengthen the security of the customer's environment.

/ What you will do

Threat intelligence & continuous improvement

  • Actively follow security developments, vulnerabilities, and threat intelligence and translate these into relevant hunts and detections.

  • Identify security risks and gaps in detection coverage and proactively propose improvements.

  • Use your knowledge of the customer's application and infrastructure landscape to continuously strengthen its security posture.

  • Contribute to the evolution of the team's security monitoring and detection strategy.

Communication & advisory

  • Translate findings into clear, actionable communication for engineers, customer stakeholders, and security specialists.

  • Contribute to security advisories and share relevant threats across the customer team and wider organization.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand system behavior and validate detection strategies.

  • Collaborate with the customer's Security Operations Center (SOC) to align security monitoring, threat detection, and response activities.

  • Help establish and improve integrations with the customer's SIEM/SOAR platform, including the forwarding of relevant logs and security telemetry.

Detection engineering & threat hunting

  • Develop and continuously improve detection use cases based on emerging threats and observed behavior.

  • Translate threat scenarios and security insights into actionable detection logic tailored to the customer's environment.

  • Proactively perform threat hunting across the application and infrastructure landscape to identify abnormal or suspicious patterns.

  • Analyze logs and telemetry data to uncover behaviors that are not yet covered by existing detections.

  • Use your understanding of the customer's technology stack to distinguish normal from potentially malicious behavior.

Use case development & response design

  • Define what should happen when detections trigger, including response actions, automation, and escalation paths.

  • Continuously refine detection logic to improve quality, relevance, and signal-to-noise ratio.

  • Build and fine-tune custom detection scenarios based on the specific characteristics and security requirements of the customer's environment.

Platform collaboration

  • Leverage our custom SIEM/SOAR-based MDR platform to implement detections and analyze data.

  • Collaborate with platform and automation engineers to improve integrations and detection capabilities.

  • Apply engineering and automation practices to ensure detection solutions are scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

/ What you bring

We are looking for someone who combines solid engineering fundamentals with a strong interest in security and is motivated to move towards or deepen their expertise in threat hunting and detection engineering.

You don't necessarily need to be an experienced threat hunter already. What matters is your ability to understand complex systems, recognize unusual behavior, and translate technical insights into practical security improvements.

Must-have skills

  • Solid engineering fundamentals, including Linux, networking, and infrastructure behavior.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or similar platforms.

  • Experience with CI/CD, Git, and configuration management or infrastructure-as-code tooling.

  • Strong automation mindset and the ability to translate problems into scalable solutions.

  • Experience working with logs and telemetry to analyze system behavior and investigate technical issues.

  • Experience with Python and/or Bash scripting.

  • Familiarity with SIEM or log analytics platforms such as OpenSearch, Elastic, Splunk, or Microsoft Sentinel.

  • Strong understanding of security principles, including threat detection and response.

  • Ability to distinguish normal from abnormal system behavior.

  • Analytical, curious, and driven to understand how systems and threats behave.

  • Ownership mindset, with responsibility for security quality and continuous improvement.

  • Strong communication skills to translate technical findings into actionable insights.

  • Ability to connect business and customer context to technical security solutions.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Hands-on experience with threat hunting, detection engineering, or advanced SOC operations.

  • Experience developing or improving detection use cases and security monitoring rules.

  • Experience with SOAR or security automation.

  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, and other Microsoft cloud services.

  • Familiarity with threat intelligence frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Experience integrating SIEM/SOAR platforms or forwarding security telemetry between different environments.

/ Who are you?

You are an engineer with a strong interest in security, driven to understand how systems behave and how threats manifest.

You don't follow playbooks blindly. You want to understand why detections exist, how systems interact, and where security can be improved.

You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy working with complex applications, infrastructure, and data. You are curious, proactive, and take ownership of the quality of your work.

You also enjoy being part of a customer team where security is a shared responsibility. You work closely with fellow engineers and security specialists, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and contribute to keeping the entire environment secure.

/ What can you expect?

At Schuberg Philis, you'll join a community of engineers with an awesome combination of exceptionally high security standards, an infatuation with automation, and the power to make a positive, sustainable impact on customers' business.

You'll work within a dedicated customer team where engineers and security specialists jointly take responsibility for the security and reliability of mission-critical environments.

Due to the nature of our customer engagements, there is no pressure on (billable) hours; we focus on quality and impact or how we like to call it: freedom & responsibility. You know best how to deliver the most value.

You'll be embedded in a company committed to helping colleagues grow as people and professionals through training, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and good old-fashioned fun.

Our offices are high-quality workspaces, and we go way beyond what is expected. We have productive equipment, good food and drinks, team outings, family days, labs to experiment with innovative technologies, etc.

We're active in relevant tech communities, attending and organizing meetups and conferences, and we organize internal knowledge-sharing events where Tech Leads play an important role.

If you're an engineer in the Netherlands with a strong interest in security and want to help secure mission-critical environments while developing or deepening your expertise in threat hunting and detection engineering, we'd love to hear from you.

description: Wat ga je doen? Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. De CAO zorgt voor een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. We willen het beste voor jou, het team en de patiënt. We denken hierbij graag met je mee wat bij jou past; Extra secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals deelname aan onze fietsregeling, zodat je met belastingvoordeel een nieuwe fiets kan kopen. Its key priorities include digital transformation, operational excellence and customer experience, all aimed at driving growth and enhancing efficiency. The Role You will take our AI stack and lead its development and customisation for the market. This is a builder and do-er role. You will design, test and implement practical and compliant agentic AI solutions on top of foundation models document understanding, classification support, retrieval over our own procedures and tariff material, and agents that carry multi-step operational work end to end. You are not being asked to train models from scratch. You are being asked to make models that already exist behave reliably enough that operations staff trust them with customs declarations, where being wrong has consequences. Working closely with Operations, Transformation, IT and Group teams, you will turn business needs into scalable solutions. Key Responsibilities • Develop and customise AI solutions for the market, from prototype through to production ownership. • Be curious and prepared to self-learn to use generative-AI to build agents that make a difference to our business • Identify automation and decision-support opportunities across customs and business processes, and size them honestly before building. • Design solutions using generative AI and large language models — retrieval, tool calling, structured extraction from customs documentation, and agentic workflows where they genuinely fit. • Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought. • Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it. • Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact. • Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners. • Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it. . Requirements Essential • 1-2 years AI engineering, software engineering or intelligent automation, including LLM or AI features that real users depended on. • Strong Python and SQL, with production code ownership. Not familiarity. • Demonstrable experience integrating large language models into production systems — prompt and context design, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output, and handling failure gracefully. • Practical experience with at least one major cloud AI platform (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex). • Solid full stack backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, testing, CI/CD. Most of this job is • Strong communication skills — you will spend real time with operations staff who are experts in customs and not in AI. • Professional fluency in English. Desirable • Evaluation engineering: building eval harnesses and regression suites for non-deterministic systems, LLM-as-judge approaches, and human-in-the-loop review design. This is the single strongest signal we look for and we will weight it heavily. • Context engineering: designing and version-controlling what a model sees — retrieval strategy, memory, tool descriptions, and policy layers that constrain what an agent is allowed to do. • Agent orchestration frameworks and standards (LangGraph, MCP, Temporal or equivalent), and experience with long-running or multi-step agent workflows. • Observability and cost control for inference at volume. What success looks like in your first year • By month three: You understand our customs processes well enough to challenge what we ask for, and you have shipped one small, useful thing. • By month six: At least one AI solution is live, measured against a baseline, and demonstrably better than what it replaced. • By month twelve: There is a working evaluation process others can use, a ranked pipeline of next opportunities, and at least two colleagues outside IT operating what you have built without you in the room. What We Offer • A key role in shaping AI capabilities. • The opportunity to build solutions with direct business impact, on real operational volume rather than pilots that never leave the lab. • An international and fast-evolving environment, with peers in other Customs Support Group markets working on the same problems. • Professional growth opportunities, including a budget for conferences, certification and model/compute costs for your own experiments. • Permanent role. That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control. description: Description QuantumDiamonds is building the world’s first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. A measurement protocol is the recipe our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) follows for one measurement: how laser, microwaves and camera are sequenced and timed, and how raw camera frames become a magnetic field image of a chip. Our engineers write new protocols whenever they test a new idea, and several backends for running them grew in parallel. You turn them into one shared Python framework that our engineers extend. The challenge is a framework R&D still uses long after your internship: flexible enough that a new protocol is a day’s work, automated enough that a measurement runs without someone watching it, and structured enough that the next engineer extends it without reading all of it. An experienced colleague from the team mentors you and sets the architecture; you make that trade-off real in code, working with Claude Code every day, as our engineers do. This is a full-time internship for 6 months, during or after your studies, starting as soon as possible. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join QuantumDiamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Bring the measurement software of Pre-Development together into one shared Python framework, to a target architecture your mentor defines, and migrate the existing measurement protocols onto it. Keep the CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions healthy as the framework grows: tests, linting, packaging, releases. Give first-pass reviews on pull requests from our engineers (tests, conventions, API conformance) before your mentor approves them. Help our engineers extend the stack: new measurement protocols become modules in the framework, and you validate the migrated ones on our QDm systems together with them. Document the framework and hand it over so the team runs it on its own after your internship. What is expected of you Enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program in computer science, software engineering, computational engineering, physics or electrical engineering with a strong software focus. Python is your working language: you structure packages, write type hints and tests, and have refactored or consolidated code you did not write. Git and CI are routine for you, and you know how to make hardware-dependent code testable: mocked instruments, recorded data and simulation, with runs on real hardware as a separate stage. AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own. You review code and take review well, you can agree on a common interface with engineers who each prefer their own solution, and you treat your colleagues as your users. Fluent in English. On-site in Munich. Experience with instrument control or lab automation in Python, with frameworks such as qudi, QCoDeS or PyMeasure, or contributions to open-source projects are a plus, not required. What we want you to bring is the patience to read code you did not write and the discipline to leave it better structured than you found it. Mentoring: An experienced colleague from the team mentors you throughout your internship. Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active. description: Help shape the future of robotics in construction. ABOUT XYZ REALITY XYZ Reality created the world’s first and only engineering-grade augmented reality solution, purpose-built for the construction industry. Our holographic technology sits within The Atom, a smart, site-safe headset and hardhat, and is used on live projects to ensure schemes are delivered on time and on budget. XYZ has grown to over 150 staff across the UK, US and Europe, and works with mission-critical organisations and construction companies to deliver major projects. THE ROLE Construction sites are some of the hardest environments for robot autonomy: they change every day and are full of clutter, obstacles and people. XYZ Reality’s robotics programme is extending our technology toward robots that can operate reliably in them, from autonomous data collection and construction progress capture through to executing construction tasks. We’re looking for a Robotics Engineer to make that real. You’ll work hands-on with robot hardware in our London office, using a modern stack (ROS 2, NVIDIA Isaac Lab, learning-based control), and see your work tested in real construction environments, not just in simulation. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on robot software and algorithmic control, backed by a good working knowledge of robot hardware. If you have strong robotics fundamentals from an MSc, PhD or applied research group, love making systems work on real robots, and want your ideas to shape the direction of a programme, we want to hear from you. This is an office-based role at our London site in Angel, Islington. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Integrate robots with XYZ’s software, bringing up ROS / ROS 2 interfaces, robot control, sensors, compute and data flows, and building repeatable tools for bring-up, configuration, logging and monitoring. Establish reliable baseline control and develop task-specific behaviours for navigation, positioning and capture, training and tuning control policies in simulation and validating them on hardware. Develop localisation-aware path planning, waypoint execution and obstacle handling, working with project and site teams to turn work plans and BIM-derived locations into robot missions. Integrate capture payloads so images, pose, timing and mission status flow reliably into XYZ’s construction progress workflows, working with navigation, SLAM and perception colleagues. Design test scenarios and measure mission completion, coverage, localisation quality, intervention, recovery and repeatability, improving the system through measured iterations. Bring technical expertise and new ideas to the programme, comparing scripted, motion-planning and learning-based approaches and helping shape what comes next. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS MSc or PhD in Robotics, Controls, Computer Science, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent applied robotics experience. Industry experience is not required. Hands-on experience building, programming or directly controlling a physical robot, from an academic project, research lab or industry. Strong Python and C++, practical ROS experience (ideally ROS 2) and working knowledge of kinematics, coordinate frames, feedback control, state estimation, path planning and robot hardware. Experience training or tuning robot control policies (e.g. reinforcement or imitation learning) using NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim or similar tools, with a rigorous experimental approach. The right to work in the UK. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS ROS / ROS 2, Python & C++ Robot control, kinematics, state estimation & path planning NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim, reinforcement or imitation learning Sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware (desirable) Navigation, SLAM, perception & sensor fusion (desirable) Mobile or field robotics, BIM/CAD or construction technology (desirable) BENEFITS 🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays 🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality 🎄 Christmas shutdown days on top of leave allowance (2–4 per year usually) 🚇 Office located within a 5-minute walk from Angel station 🪙 Annual salary reviews 🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties 🍣 Free lunch on Thursdays, followed by after-work drinks 💰 Employee referral scheme 🚀 Make a real-world impact by helping transform the construction industry Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
