description: Tiger Analytics is an advanced analytics consulting firm. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 100 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI. Our business value and leadership have been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner. We are looking for an Ontology Architect to lead high-impact applied Engineering and analytics initiatives. This role combines deep technical expertise, strong experimentation rigor, and business leadership to influence product direction and drive measurable outcomes at scale. Responsibilities: Ontology & Taxonomy Design: Lead the creation, modeling, and evolution of enterprise-wide ontologies, taxonomies, and controlled vocabularies that accurately represent complex business domains. Knowledge Graph Architecture: Design and implement scalable architecture, ingestion pipelines, and governance for enterprise Knowledge Graphs (Triple Stores or Property Graphs). Semantic Layer Strategy: Build and maintain the enterprise semantic layer to abstract physical data complexities, providing a unified, machine-readable business view of data. Data Product Augmentation: Partner with domain data teams to map, link, and augment decentralized Data Products using the central ontology to ensure semantic interoperability across the organization. Inference & Reasoning: Implement semantic reasoning and inference rules to automatically generate new metadata and uncover hidden insights within the graph. Governance & Standards: Establish best practices, version control mechanisms, and data contracts for semantic models, ensuring consistent graph schema updates across business units. Requirements Semantic Standards: Expert-level mastery of core semantic technologies Knowledge Graph Engineering: Hands-on experience designing and operating production-grade Graph Databases / Triple Stores (e.g., GraphDB, Stardog, Amazon Neptune, AllegroGraph, or Neo4j). Ontology Modeling Tools: Proficiency with industry-standard ontology engineering and taxonomy management software (e.g., Protégé, TopBraid Composer, PoolParty). Modern Data Frameworks: Clear, practical understanding of Data Mesh paradigms, specifically how to design a semantic layer that overlays federated, domain-driven Data Products. Traditional Data Modeling: Strong baseline in classic data concepts, including relational databases, dimensional modeling, and ETL/ELT integration patterns. Preferred Skills Data Quality & Validation: Hands-on experience to enforce data quality and constraint validation across graph structures. Advanced AI & Graph Analytics: Familiarity with graph algorithms, graph machine learning (GNNs), or leveraging Knowledge Graphs to enhance Large Language Model architectures via Graph RAG (Retrieval-Aug Generation). Benefits Significant career development opportunities exist as the company grows. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a small, fast-growing, challenging and entrepreneurial environment, with a high degree of individual responsibility. Tiger Analytics provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. description: About Schema App Schema App is a fast-growing, profitable SaaS company headquartered in Guelph, Ontario, with a team across Canada. We're a smart, collaborative group driven by a shared mission: to become a global leader in enterprise marketing technology and help organizations future-proof for the age of AI. We work with some of the world's most recognized enterprises, including SAP, Wells Fargo, and Henry Ford Health, to give them control over how their brand is understood and represented by AI across search and digital experiences. At our core, we believe that in the age of AI, a brand is only as strong as the data behind it and the connections within it. As search evolves into AI-driven and agent-led experiences, that foundation becomes critical. That's why we're building the infrastructure enterprises need to control how they show up in AI today and compete in the agentic web tomorrow: driving growth, protecting their brand, and leading in the next generation of digital experiences. Our platform helps enterprises build and govern the semantic data layer that search engines, AI and agents rely on: deploying Schema Markup and entity linking at scale, turning content into a governed Content Knowledge Graph, and activating that data across AI experiences, including Knowledge Assistant, our grounded, cited answer experience powered by NLWeb. Visit Schema App at or on LinkedIn. The role We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to own product strategy for a major part of Schema App's platform and to raise the bar for how we build products as a team. This is a senior individual-contributor leadership role. You'll set multi-quarter direction for a product line, make the hard trade-offs explicit, and turn strategy into shipped outcomes in partnership with Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success. You'll also be a multiplier: coaching and mentoring the product managers around you, including a PM-in-training, and helping shape the product frameworks and practices our team uses every day. We're looking for an experienced, well-rounded product leader with deep B2B SaaS experience, comfortable in a startup through scale-up environment, who is energized by how AI search and agentic experiences are reshaping how brands are found and chosen. If that sounds like you, show us in your application. This role reports to Mark van Berkel, COO and co-founder. What you'll do Own product strategy across quarters: Define and drive the multi-quarter strategy and roadmap for a product line, connecting market shifts in AI search, answer engines and agents to clear product bets, and grounding trade-offs in usage data, customer feedback and business impact. Lead platform, API and packaging decisions: Shape how our platform, integrations and APIs are designed and exposed to customers and partners, and partner with leadership on pricing and packaging so that what we build is easy to buy, adopt and expand. Coach PMs and raise how we build: Raise the craft of the product team through regular coaching, feedback and modelling, including mentoring a PM-in-training, and partner with the Product Community of Practice to evolve our roadmap, prioritization and go-to-market (GTM) frameworks, keeping them lightweight and practical. Be a trusted presence with enterprise customers: Lead discovery with enterprise customers and prospects, represent the roadmap in executive and customer conversations, and bring first-hand customer evidence back into strategy and prioritization. Drive go-to-market outcomes: Partner with Marketing and Customer Success on positioning, launches, Sales and CSM enablement, and adoption tracking. Lead with AI and agent fluency: Use AI copilots and agentic tools to work faster, with clear judgment about what to verify versus trust, and bring a strong point of view on how AI answer engines and agents retrieve and act on structured content. What you bring (must-haves) 8+ years as a product manager, with deep hands-on experience in B2B SaaS. Ownership of a product line or product strategy across several quarters, with clear evidence of shipped outcomes and measurable impact (adoption, retention, revenue), not just responsibilities. A track record of coaching and mentoring product managers, including helping a more junior or early-career PM grow their craft. Pricing and packaging, or platform/API product experience: you've shaped how a product is packaged and monetized, or owned a platform, integration or API product used by customers or partners. Executive presence with enterprise customers: you're credible and comfortable leading discovery, roadmap and strategy conversations with senior stakeholders at large organizations. Strong cross-functional partnership with Engineering and GTM teams (Marketing, Sales and Customer Success), and the ability to bring people along through change. Data-informed decision making: you use adoption metrics, customer behaviour and usage trends to set priorities, define success criteria and measure impact. Technical competency: you understand technical trade-offs well enough to have meaningful architecture and feasibility discussions with Engineering. Nice to haves Depth in AI, semantic web, knowledge graphs or data platforms (a strong plus): for example LLM or AI search products, schema.org and structured data, RDF or linked data, or data-platform and developer products. Experience with SEO, martech, content platforms or answer-engine optimization (AEO). Experience introducing or scaling product frameworks or a product community of practice across teams. Experience running customer-facing webinars, enablement or launch programs. A technical background (computer science or engineering degree, former engineer, solutions or analytics role). Startup or scale-up experience in an environment that needed more process and execution discipline. How we work / location This is a full-time, remote role. Schema App is headquartered in Guelph, Ontario, with a team across Canada. Schema App's Core Values Growth Mindset: You're curious, ambitious, and always looking for ways to improve, whether that's evolving how we build products, learning from customers and data, or experimenting with new AI and agentic tools. Resourceful: You turn ambiguity into action. You use data, customer insight, AI tools, and the expertise around you to make informed decisions and keep work moving, without waiting for perfect information or perfect conditions. One Team: Great products are built cross-functionally. You build strong partnerships with Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, and other teams, creating shared ownership of product decisions, launches, and outcomes. Humble: You bring strong product judgment without assuming you have all the answers. You listen to customers, users, and teammates, make your thinking transparent, and change course when what you learn points to a better path. Life @ Schema App Culture focused on your growth: Weekly 1:1 with conversations around Professional Development Great benefits for health & wellness, and your coverage starts as soon as you do RRSP matching! Flex days to re-energize on top of vacation days and you don't work on your birthday The Culture Club keeps our virtual team connected through fun and innovative events Diverse smart team! The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be Schema App's purpose is to build meaningful connections, with each other, our customers, and the data so that we are all understood. We are a team of smart people helping each other solve hard problems. AI-based tools may be used to support screening; all resumes are reviewed by a member of our team. If you require accommodation during the application process, please let us know. We are committed to an inclusive work environment and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives. description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Are you passionate about building robust data architectures that power next-generation, AI-driven business intelligence? Do you thrive in the intersection of data engineering and analytics, wearing both hats to design scalable backends and deliver actionable insights? We are looking for a Senior Marketing Analytics Manager - Business Intelligence & Data Architecture to join our Marketing Analytics team. In this role, you will work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Data Engineering teams to build the foundational "Gold Layers" and semantic models that enable self-serve reporting and agentic AI workflows. This is a great opportunity for a highly technical analyst who is hands-on with Python, Databricks, and SQL, and is excited about creating the infrastructure that enables AI for BI. If you’re energized by the challenge of bridging the gap between raw data pipelines and advanced analytical outputs, we’d love to hear from you. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. In this role, you will: Act as the bridge between Data Engineering and Marketing Analytics, designing, building, and maintaining robust ETL pipelines and "Gold Layer" tables in Databricks. Develop and document semantic layers, data dictionaries, and markdown files designed specifically to train and enable AI agents for scalable, self-serve BI. Develop dashboards and analyses to surface business-critical KPIs and assess sales and marketing performance. Perform ad-hoc reporting and deep dives to uncover key insights across programs and initiatives to inform strategy and decision making. Partner with marketing stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable data models and analytics-ready datasets. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum requirements for the role: Bachelor's in Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Economics or other related analytical fields. 5+ years of relevant analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence or data engineering work experience. Expert in SQL, python, DBT and visualization platforms (Tableau preferred). Hands-on experience working with Databricks (or similar lakehouse architectures) to transform and model large datasets. Experience building data backends, semantic layers, and structured documentation optimized for AI ingestion and agentic workflows. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with experience in data analysis. Comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate data transformation, analysis, and visualization workflows. description: Obsidian Security is the leading SaaS security platform, trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Algolia. We protect 200+ organizations across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, including many of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies. Founded in 2017 and backed by top investors like Greylock, Obsidian was built to close a critical gap: securing SaaS apps where business happens—Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. The company does this by offering a complete SaaS security platform to reduce risk, detect and respond to threats, and prevent breaches at the source. Obsidian was built by leaders who redefined endpoint and identity security at CrowdStrike, Okta, Cylance, and Carbon Black. Now, they’re transforming how SaaS is secured. With AI driving rapid SaaS growth and complexity, agentic AI tools gain privileged access to sensitive data through integrations, creating new risks most security tools miss. Obsidian uniquely detects anomalous OAuth token activity and manages integration risks. Major announcements are on the horizon. Recognizing that SaaS security needs to evolve, Obsidian enables growing organizations to start with a lightweight, prevention-focused browser extension and expand coverage over time. With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and a major fundraise ahead, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness. We are hiring a Sr Technical Marketing Manager - Alliances & Competitive Strategy to own two of the highest-leverage narratives at Obsidian: why we are better together with our strategic partners, and why our architecture solves problems no one else can. This role sits at the intersection of alliances marketing and technical product marketing, and it owns competitive intelligence for the company. You will define how Obsidian shows up alongside our strategic technology alliances, building the joint value propositions, launch narratives, and enablement that turn partnerships into pipeline and supporting the GTM models that bring those alliances to market. At the same time, you will go deep with Product and Engineering to understand how the platform works, from our knowledge graph to our data depth and detection architecture, and elevate that "how" into a durable "why": why Obsidian is uniquely positioned to secure third-party applications and AI agents where alternative architectures structurally fall short. You will be the positioning authority the field, our partners, and our executives turn to for evidence-based answers on how we win, both in architecture and in direct competition. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can think strategically, move quickly, and help shape how we scale both partner marketing and competitive positioning at Obsidian. What you’ll accomplish Own the Alliance Narrative Develop joint positioning, messaging, and better-together value propositions for strategic technology alliances Build messaging that helps customers understand when and why to adopt Obsidian alongside partner platforms, and helps alliance partners position Obsidian with clarity and conviction Lead product marketing for joint launches, co-marketing campaigns, and major alliance field moments, coordinating across alliances, product, and marketing teams Support the GTM models behind each alliance, including marketplace, co-sell, and integration motions, with the positioning, content, and enablement they need to perform Create enablement that alliance sellers actually use: solution briefs, pitch decks, objection-handling guides, and co-branded campaign materials Drive co-marketing programs with strategic alliances that deliver measurable pipeline contribution and deal acceleration Own Competitive Intelligence & Technical Positioning Own the competitive intelligence function: monitor competitor products, architectures, disclosures, and market signals, and distill them into succinct, actionable guidance for sales, product, and leadership Build and maintain the compete program, including battlecards, compete decks, objection handling, and win/loss insights, that gives the field and partners clear evidence for why Obsidian wins Elevate "how we do things" into "why it matters": articulate why Obsidian's architecture solves problems that point tools and adjacent platforms cannot Develop technical marketing content such as architecture narratives, technical briefs, blogs, webinars, and demos that proves differentiation rather than asserting it Bring competitive and market insights back into product, alliances, and executive planning to sharpen roadmap framing and GTM strategy About You Technical to the core, fluent in the "why." 8+ years in product, technical, or partner marketing in cybersecurity or enterprise software, ideally with a hands-on technical background. A competitive strategist. You have built compete programs and turn competitor analysis and win/loss data into positioning the field trusts. You know the difference between a feature comparison and a structural advantage. Experienced in technology alliance marketing. You have built better-together narratives, joint launches, and enablement with strategic technology partners, and understand marketplace, co-sell, and integration GTM motions. Fluent in the cybersecurity buyer. You know how security leaders evaluate and buy, and how to help alliance partners have that conversation on Obsidian's behalf. Strategic, hands-on, and collaborative. You see the big picture but are comfortable writing, building, and shipping the work yourself, and you align alliances, sales, product, and engineering without owning all the decisions. Our US based employees enjoy: Competitive compensation with equity and 401k Comprehensive healthcare with dental and vision coverage Flexible paid time off and paid holiday time off 12 weeks of new parent or family leave Personal and professional development resources For more details on our US benefits, or for information on our international benefits, please see here. Pay Transparancy Please note that the base pay range is a guideline and for candidates who receive an offer, the base pay will vary based on factors such as work location, as well as the knowledge, skills and experience of the candidate. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible for equity awards and may be eligible for sales commission or incentive compensation based on the role or function within the company. description: About Us At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work." TeamSnap is seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Backend, to join our fully distributed engineering team and help us continue scaling systems that serve millions of daily users and tens of thousands of amateur sports organizations. Our stack includes Node, TypeScript, Elixir, Ruby/Rails, SQL, React, cloud-based services, event-driven systems, queues, background jobs, caching layers, and observability tooling. We are looking for a hands-on Staff Backend Engineer who can build and improve APIs and services, reason through production issues across the system, lead technical design in ambiguous areas, mentor engineers, and raise the quality bar across the team. This person should be comfortable working closely with infrastructure, platform, and data teams without being expected to own those functions directly. As an engineering team, we architect and build scalable systems using service-oriented and event-driven architecture. This role will help shape the technical foundation behind TeamSnap’s product experience, with a focus on backend systems, APIs, services, data performance, reliability, observability, and production quality. What You'll Do: Architect, build, and evolve backend APIs, services, event-driven workflows, queues, background jobs, data models, caching strategies, and integrations that support millions of users and thousands of sports organizations. Own complex backend product and technical work from discovery through design, implementation, rollout, production support, and long term maintainability. Lead ambiguous technical initiatives by breaking down problems, identifying risks, making practical tradeoffs, and helping teams move from uncertainty to clear execution. Improve the reliability, scalability, performance, and operability of production systems through thoughtful architecture, strong testing practices, database optimization, caching, monitoring, alerting, and incident follow-up. Debug complex production issues by reasoning across application code, databases, caches, queues, jobs, observability data, and the broader request lifecycle. Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform, Data, Support, and other teams to turn roadmap needs into durable backend systems and practical delivery plans. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to give and receive constructive feedback, mentor engineers, influence cross-team alignment and articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders What Will Set You Up for Success: Strong Node expertise with experience building and maintaining production backend systems. Staff level backend engineering depth, with a strong track record building and operating high-scale APIs, services, distributed systems, or shared product capabilities in production. Strong command of backend technologies such as Node, TypeScript, Elixir, Ruby/Rails, Java, Go, Python, or similar, including runtime behavior, failure modes, and production tradeoffs. Strong SQL and relational database judgment, including indexing, query optimization, migrations, profiling, data modeling, transactions, read and write patterns, and performance tuning. Practical understanding of service-oriented architecture, event-driven architecture, queues, background jobs, webhooks, Redis or similar caching tools, and systems that need to scale under real production load. Working knowledge of production infrastructure and platform concerns, enough to reason through deployments, containers, CI/CD pipelines, cloud services, networking basics, observability, and operational debugging. Strong production ownership mindset, with the ability to use logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, incident reviews, and system behavior to improve reliability over time. Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, mentor engineers, facilitate technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and connect backend technical choices to customer impact, business needs, and long term maintainability. Bonus: Previous work in or close partnership with infrastructure, platform, SRE, DevOps, or data teams. Familiarity with Elasticsearch, BigQuery, analytics pipelines, search infrastructure, reporting workflows, or high-volume data processing. Responsible use of AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve debugging, testing, documentation, refactoring, prototyping, or developer experience without compromising quality or understanding. Compensation Additional Information Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here. Compensation We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $200,000 inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Location TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time. Opportunities to Grow At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it. Total Rewards • We're proud to be remote-first. We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool • Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary) • 100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family • 401K to help you invest for the future • $1,500 annual learning and development stipend • Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events • Generous home office allowance to set you up for success • TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter • A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more! • TeamSnap Total Rewards Working at TeamSnap At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit, you're a culture add. Check out our Culture Playbook and learn how we succeed at being remote-first, what makes our company so unique, and how we're inspired by our people, our customers, and our values. Inclusion and Diversity Creativity and innovation can't thrive when we're cookie-cutter images of each other. We’re quickly growing more diverse, but there's always room for improvement. We are committed to inclusion and diversity at TeamSnap, and we hold ourselves accountable for building an environment where everyone feels valued. If you need any disability-related adaptation during the recruitment process, just let us know! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

description: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. Why This Role Matters Our GTM Analytics team owns the metrics that run the business for Sales, Marketing, and Client Success. We're past the phase of standing up basic reporting — we're now building a modern, agentic analytics practice, including Lighthouse, our internal BI-as-code platform, where dashboards, metrics, and semantic definitions live in version-controlled code rather than scattered across disconnected tools. This role is a chance to shape that next chapter. You'll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CS leaders to answer their hardest questions about pipeline, funnel conversion, campaign performance, and retention, while helping build the infrastructure and AI-forward workflows that let the whole GTM org get trustworthy answers faster. You'll report to our Senior Manager of Analytics and work in tight, two-week sprints alongside Analytics Engineering, so you'll see your work ship and get used — fast. What You'll Do GTM Analysis & Decision Support Deliver decision-ready analysis across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success: pipeline health, funnel conversion, campaign and channel performance, cohort/retention, and GRR/NRR drivers. Partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CSM stakeholders to scope questions, frame recommendations, and see analysis through to a decision — not just a dashboard handoff. Bring structure to ambiguous asks — translate a stakeholder's question into a clear, testable analytical approach. Data Modeling & Quality Build and maintain dbt models and marts for Sales, Marketing, and CS domains, with Salesforce as a core source system. Own data quality and documentation for your domain: clear definitions, source-of-truth tables, and QA that stakeholders can trust without double-checking. Lighthouse & Agentic Analytics Contribute to Lighthouse, our BI-as-code platform, as we build it out — help define how dashboards, metrics, and semantic models get written, versioned, and reviewed like software. Note: Lighthouse is an active build, not a finished platform — you'll be shaping it, not just using it. Push our analytics workflows toward agentic AI: using AI agents to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting, and cut down on manual, one-off dashboard requests. Bring a point of view on where AI can replace manual analyst work versus where it can't — you should be as comfortable prompting and evaluating an agent as writing the SQL yourself. How You'll Work Operate in two-week sprints, planning and prioritizing your own backlog against team OKRs alongside your manager. Give clear, proactive status updates to stakeholders rather than waiting to be asked. What We're Looking For Experience 5+ years in analytics/BI, with meaningful time supporting Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success functions at a fast-growing company. Staff-level candidates should bring deeper scope — larger or more ambiguous problems owned end-to-end, and a track record of setting technical direction, not just executing against it. Expert SQL and hands-on dbt experience modeling GTM data. Comfortable with Python for analysis and automation — this isn't a heavy ML/stats role, but you know how to script your way out of manual work. Experience with Salesforce as a data source — you understand CRM objects, fields, and the quirks of modeling data. Familiarity with a modern data stack: Fivetran or similar EL tooling, and a cloud warehouse (we run Snowflake; BigQuery experience also welcome). BI & AI Fluency Experience with at least one modern BI tool (Sigma, Hex, Tableau, Looker, or similar) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement — what matters more is that you understand how modern BI organizations operate: governed semantic layers, self-serve dashboards, and BI-as-code approaches. Genuine curiosity about agentic analytics — you've used AI agents or LLM tools to speed up analysis, and you want to help define what that looks like at scale. We build with Claude day-to-day, so hands-on experience with Claude Code (or a similar coding agent like Codex) is a big plus — you'll use it to move faster on dbt models, scripting, and analysis, not just as a novelty. Mindset Strong communicator who can frame a recommendation clearly for a non-technical stakeholder and defend it under questioning. Comfortable with the accountability of owning a deliverable through to closure, not just the analysis in the middle. Energized by ambiguity and fast iteration — two-week sprints mean you'll ship early and often. Compensation Additional Information Join us in shaping the future of real estate The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages. We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition. Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date. More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner. Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform. Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. The Opportunity Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time, fully remote physician consultants who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across multiple U.S. states. Depending on your licensure, certification, and area of expertise, you will provide consultations in menopause and perimenopause care aligned to The Menopause Society and ACOG guidelines, early fertility support aligned to ACOG and ASRM guidelines, or both. Metabolic health is a core, cross-cutting component of this program. Weight, insulin resistance, and cardiometabolic risk are central to outcomes across every journey we support, from ovulatory function and preconception readiness to menopausal symptom burden and long-term cardiovascular and bone health. You should expect metabolic assessment and management to be a routine part of your visits, and clinicians comfortable prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists, within clinical protocols are especially encouraged to apply. This is a flexible, part-time contractor engagement of approximately 5-40 hours per week, with a target commitment of 10-15 hours per week. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Provide virtual consultations (video and/or phone) within your area(s) of expertise, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, and ongoing management of menopausal, fertility, and related hormonal and metabolic concerns. Apply current ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines with individualized, shared decision-making. Assess and manage metabolic health as a routine part of visits, including prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications such as GLP-1 receptor agonists within clinical protocols where appropriate. Document visits accurately and on time, order and interpret relevant labs, and coordinate referrals to primary care, OB/GYN, endocrinology, behavioral health, or subspecialists as needed. Maintain active, unrestricted multi-state clinical licensure, complete credentialing and payer enrollment, and maintain eligibility for additional state licenses to expand coverage. Contribute to member experience and quality through strong virtual visit presence, effective use of telehealth and EHR systems, participation in chart audits and case reviews, and staying current with emerging research and regulatory changes. What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Established a consistent panel of high-quality virtual visits within your clinical area(s), with strong member experience and visit quality results. Maintained timely, accurate documentation and lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps. Expanded your state licensure coverage in line with program needs, supporting broader member access. Integrated metabolic assessment and management, including GLP-1 protocols where clinically appropriate, as a routine part of your visits. Contributed to chart audits, case reviews, and clinical protocol refinement as the telemedicine program scales. About You ✨ You likely have: An MD or DO in Obstetrics/Gynecology, Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility (REI), Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Endocrinology; or you are a Physician Assistant (PA) or Advanced Practice Registered Nurse/Nurse Practitioner (e.g., WHNP, adult/gerontology NP, FNP) with demonstrated expertise in the applicable clinical area. A minimum of 3-5+ years of active clinical experience in early fertility support, menopause care, or both, including evaluation, treatment, and longitudinal management. An active, unrestricted U.S. medical license; multi-state licensure is preferred and IMLC participation is strongly preferred. For clinicians practicing in the menopause specialty: MSCP certification from The Menopause Society, or certification actively in progress with a clear completion plan. Familiarity with ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines. Prior telemedicine experience (preferred), with comfort managing visits entirely in a virtual environment and a strong virtual presence that supports shared decision-making over video and phone. Proficiency with telehealth technologies, including video platforms, secure messaging, electronic prescribing, and EHR/clinical documentation tools. Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, along with a HIPAA-compliant home workspace and reliable internet. Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Clinical experience spanning both early fertility and menopause, enabling flexible coverage across member journeys. Experience working in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, or comparable specialty program. Familiarity with early fertility workup, including AMH testing, ovulation induction, and preconception optimization, with appropriate escalation to in-person ART evaluation. Experience prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists (titration, side-effect management, monitoring, and discontinuation planning); obesity medicine training or ABOM certification is a significant advantage. Prior experience in digital health, health benefits, or multi-state telemedicine environments. Experience contributing to clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or member-facing clinical content. Experience supporting diverse and historically underserved populations, including LGBTQ+ and gender-diverse individuals. Fluency in an additional language. Every virtual visit shapes how members navigate some of the most personal moments of their lives, from trying to conceive to managing menopause. The clinicians in this network are the face of that experience, and the quality of their judgment, communication, and documentation determines whether members receive care they trust. description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com. Who We Are: The Knowledge Graph Platform team builds the foundational systems that help Reddit understand entities, relationships, and context across its content. We are evolving an advanced, AI-powered knowledge graph into a reliable, scalable platform that enables teams across Reddit to build better experiences on top of shared, high-quality knowledge. This is a high-leverage team at the intersection of data, platform engineering, and AI. Our work supports emerging capabilities such as contextual grounding while creating the contracts, standards, and developer experience that make shared data dependable and easy to use. This team is strategically positioned to impact both ads and consumer roadmaps. Our data is used across ads marketplace models as well as user-facing features on reddit.com. What You’ll Do: Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers building Reddit’s Knowledge Graph Platform; create a high-trust, high-performing environment with clear goals and strong technical ownership. Set the technical direction and roadmap for a scalable knowledge graph platform, including data and API contracts, service interfaces, reliability, observability, performance, and developer experience. Leverage SOTA LLM and agentic patterns for knowledge graph construction. Establish production-grade operating standards: defining SLOs, implementing quality measures of data within the knowledge graph, governance mechanisms, and safe change-management practices. Partner with engineering, computational linguists, and domain-expert teams to define a shared operating model for ontology, data quality, governance, and platform evolution. Be a steward of data in the KG - ensure the graph has the coverage and freshness needed for priority use cases. Work with our dedicated data labeler team on shared goals around data coverage and quality. Work closely with internal product and engineering teams to understand their needs, prioritize high-value use cases, and increase access to the platform. Drive the next wave of graph-powered capabilities, including opportunities in shopping, search, ads marketplace models, consumer feed models. Stay close to architecture and technical design, helping the team navigate complex system tradeoffs and contribute hands-on when it is the highest-leverage path. Communicate the team’s strategy, priorities, risks, and progress clearly across a distributed, cross-functional organization. Who You Might Be: 8+ years of total software engineering experience, with 2+ years directly managing, coaching, and developing engineering teams. Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic or ontology systems, entity resolution, search, or contextual grounding is highly desired. Experience building or operating AI/ML powered, or data-intensive platforms, with a proven track record of leading shared technical systems with multiple internal customers. Strong understanding of how to turn a technical system into a product-like platform: setting an operating model with customers, establishing data or service-level contracts, useful documentation, and a path to self-service adoption. Experience establishing data contracts around quality, lineage, or governance. Strong technical judgment across distributed systems, backend services, data platforms, APIs, reliability, and operational excellence. Comfortable making technical and product tradeoffs in ambiguity, including when a dedicated product manager is not present. Excellent collaborator and communicator who can earn trust with engineers, senior leaders, and partner teams across time zones. Enjoy building clarity and durable operating mechanisms where ownership and processes are still evolving. Excel in evangelization and driving platform adoption cross org. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. Become a Senior Data Engineer for Bloomreach! Join our newly formed Datacraft team — the team building the next-generation data platform that powers internal Databricks, the Loomi Marketing Agent with Data Insights capability for Bloomreach Marketing platform. Your engineering work will directly impact how hundreds of enterprise customers access, understand, and activate their Bloomreach data internally and with data share in Databricks and BigQuery. The base salary range for this position at the P3 / Senior Software Engineer level is CZK 1 300 000 - CZK 1 600 000. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Working in one of our Central European offices (Bratislava, Brno or Prague) or from home on a full-time basis, you'll become a core part of the Engineering team. What challenge awaits you? You will join the Datacraft team as one of its founding engineers. Datacraft is a new team in the Engagement pillar, established to tackle three interconnected domains: Data Warehouses (~60% of team domain) — making Bloomreach data first-class in customer Databricks. The strategic goal for 27 is to use Databricks to exponentially accelerate data adoption — both for customers who want their data outside Bloomreach and for Bloomreach itself to build analytics faster. Dashboards & Analytics Stack (~20%) — moving Marketing reporting and dashboarding from the proprietary stack onto Databrick. Datacraft is an AI-first team. We believe code is a commodity and expect every engineer to fluently use coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI) as a core part of their daily workflow. The ability to leverage AI tooling to accelerate development, prototyping, and problem-solving is not optional — it's foundational. We rely heavily on knowledge graphs and spec driven development. As a P3 (Senior) engineer at Bloomreach you are an independent professional — expert in at least one component, able to decompose objectives into tasks, and lead small projects end-to-end with minimal day-to-day guidance. Your job will be to: a. Build the Databricks data platform — Design data pipelines (Kafka → Flink -> GCS Iceberg → Databricks) following medallion architecture using Databricks notebooks and Spark Declarative Pipeline. Own data models and ETL mutations for ID resolution and consent semantics. Maintain orchestration (Airflow / Cloud Composer) and monitoring. b. Co-build dashboards & analytics stack — Design canonical metrics and models on Databricks, support semantic layers and BI tools (Cube, Looker Studio), ensure tight Marketing Agent (Insights skill) integration. Our tech stack Python, Go, Kafka, Databricks, Airflow, Flink (Java), GCP, Mongo, Redis, Airflow, DataProc, Spark, Apache Flink, Databricks, Kubernetes, Terraform, Grafana, Prometheus, PagerDuty, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, GitLab CI/CD, Claude Code Your success story 30 Days: Understand the Datacraft domain, complete onboarding, set up your dev environment, and get oriented on Databricks architecture and Marketing Agent. 90 Days: Ship your first pipeline, data model, or orchestration improvement to production. Join architecture discussions and the on-call rotation. 180 Days: Own a component end-to-end. Make informed trade-off decisions independently. Contribute to measurable team goals. You have the following experience and qualities: Professional experience Solid data engineering background with strong SQL and data modeling skills (star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, partitioning/clustering, etc.). Hands-on experience building production-grade data pipelines on Databricks and GCP, ideally involving Flink, Iceberg, Spark on DataProc. Experience with orchestration and workflow tools — specifically Airflow / Cloud Composer — and comfort working with DAG-based systems for scheduled and event-driven jobs. Familiarity with open table formats (Iceberg preferred, Delta Lake / Hudi acceptable) and how they interact with query engines and DWH platforms. Strong programming skills in Python (preferred); Scala/Java/Go also relevant. Good understanding of data quality, lineage, and observability (monitoring SLAs/SLOs, detecting missing/late loads, backfilling strategies). Ability to work across product and engineering teams, turning fuzzy problem statements into incremental, shippable slices. Strongly preferred Background in marketing analytics, CDPs, or BI/semantic layers (Looker, dbt, Cube). Experience with Snowflake or Databricks or BigQuery. Experience with spec driven development, knowledge graphs, agentic harnesses or AI-powered analytics Personal qualities Ownership & accountability · Sharp and Product thinking · Clear communication · Bias for reliability · Continuous improvement mindset · Comfortable remote-first in Central Europe. #LI-KP1 More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce. We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: As an Enterprise Sales Executive on Toptal’s Consumer Products & Services (CP&S) team, your mission is to win new enterprise clients and secure new business bookings. You will build your own pipeline, open doors into organizations where Toptal does not currently do business, develop opportunities, and close new commercial deals. This is a pure hunter role for accomplished sales professionals who thrive on creating opportunities, competing for business, and turning new relationships into meaningful revenue. You will lead the end-to-end new-client acquisition process, from identifying target accounts and engaging decision-makers to shaping solutions, negotiating commercial terms, and securing the first revenue booking. Working closely with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders, you will develop compelling solutions, navigate complex buying processes, and close new business. You will partner with Client Partners to ensure a seamless transition following the initial booking, allowing you to remain focused on what you do best: opening new doors and winning new clients. We are looking for exceptional business developers who combine deep Consumer Products & Services industry expertise, executive credibility, and consultative selling skills with the urgency, persistence, and competitive drive of a true hunter. You understand the business and technology challenges facing consumer products, retail, and services organizations, and know how to translate those challenges into compelling commercial opportunities. You leverage your industry knowledge and relationships to navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, engage senior decision-makers, and create demand where none exists. You take ownership of your results, thrive on winning new clients, and do not wait for opportunities to come to you. Consumer products and retail organizations are under pressure to move faster than their current operating models allow. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rethinking how work gets done across brand and marketing, commercial operations, supply chain, and digital commerce. Toptal’s CP&S team already partners with some of the world’s largest consumer products organizations to help address these challenges. You will bring together our capabilities across technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent to help new clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes. This is a high-accountability, high-reward opportunity for individuals who want direct ownership of their commercial results and the opportunity to build a substantial business through their own efforts. This is a remote position with a strong expectation of regular, in-person client engagement and field activity. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. You will be responsible for building and converting a pipeline of net-new enterprise clients across Consumer Products & Services. You will identify high-potential organizations, develop access to decision-makers, uncover business challenges, and create opportunities for Toptal to compete and win. You will lead the sales process from initial engagement through securing the first revenue booking, working closely with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders to shape compelling solutions, navigate complex buying processes, and close new business. Your focus is exclusively on acquiring new clients. You will not inherit an existing book of business or carry ongoing account management and expansion responsibilities. Following the initial revenue booking, new clients transition to Client Partners and the appropriate delivery teams. Hunt and win new enterprise clients. Own new-logo acquisition and secured bookings across consumer products, retail, and services organizations, with direct accountability for identifying, developing, and closing new business. Build your own pipeline. Proactively identify target accounts, develop prospecting strategies, leverage your CP&S industry network, and create new opportunities through consistent, disciplined outreach. Partner with SDRs to accelerate prospecting without depending on them to generate your pipeline. Open doors at the executive level. Establish relationships with senior business and technology leaders, economic buyers, and key decision-makers within organizations where Toptal does not have an established commercial relationship. Create demand and shape opportunities. Engage prospective clients around their strategic priorities, identify business problems worth solving, and position Toptal’s capabilities in ways that create compelling reasons to act. Bring informed perspectives on the commercial, operational, and technology challenges shaping the consumer products and retail industries. Lead and close complex sales pursuits. Own the full sales cycle, including qualification, discovery, stakeholder alignment, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, procurement, contracting, and securing the initial revenue booking. Compete and win. Develop winning strategies to displace incumbent providers, differentiate Toptal from traditional consulting and technology services firms, and navigate competitive enterprise buying processes. Sell the full breadth of Toptal’s capabilities. Work with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders to bring together specialized talent, technology, AI, marketing, consulting, and managed services solutions addressing client challenges across digital commerce, supply chain, customer experience, commercial operations, and business transformation. Maintain a high-quality, self-generated pipeline. Build sufficient qualified pipeline to consistently deliver new-logo and bookings targets. Maintain accurate opportunity intelligence, forecasting, and disciplined sales execution. Take ownership of commercial outcomes. Drive opportunities forward with urgency, navigate obstacles, negotiate effectively, and remain personally accountable for securing booked revenue. Execute clean client transitions. Ensure commercial commitments, initial booking details, and relevant client context are transferred to Client Partners and delivery teams, allowing you to return your focus to new-client acquisition. Build a strong market presence. Spend meaningful time in front of prospective clients, developing relationships through executive networking, CP&S industry events, referrals, and direct engagement. We are seeking people who enjoy the hunt as much as the win. You should be energized by breaking into new accounts, creating opportunities from scratch, and securing business that would not exist without your efforts. In the first week, expect to: Onboard with Toptal, learning our business model, value proposition, and capabilities. Familiarize yourself with our sales methodologies, prospecting tools, and commercial processes. Understand our CP&S industry strategy, target client profiles, priority segments, and markets. Meet the Industry, Sales Development, and internal subject matter experts and stakeholders who will support your success. Become familiar with our contracting, legal, and commercial processes. In the first month, expect to: Develop a targeted new-logo acquisition plan with your CP&S Industry GM, identifying priority accounts, executive buyers, and initial pursuit strategies. Begin actively prospecting into new consumer products, retail, and services accounts, leveraging your existing industry relationships while building new ones. Establish a consistent cadence of outbound activity, executive outreach, and new-business development. Coordinate with SDRs to expand target-account coverage and accelerate opportunity creation. Begin discovery conversations with prospective clients and build your initial qualified pipeline. Develop a strong understanding of how to position Toptal’s technology, AI, marketing, consulting, managed services, and talent capabilities against the priorities and challenges facing CP&S organizations. In the first three months, expect to: Establish a measurable pipeline of qualified net-new CP&S enterprise opportunities, including a meaningful contribution from your own prospecting and relationship development. Build relationships with economic buyers and senior decision-makers across priority target accounts. Lead active sales pursuits, working with internal subject matter experts to develop differentiated solutions and competitive proposals tailored to consumer products, retail, and services organizations. Demonstrate the ability to qualify, advance, and close opportunities through complex enterprise buying processes. Secure initial new-logo wins and revenue bookings, building momentum toward your commercial targets. Maintain an accurate, well-managed pipeline with clear next steps, close strategies, and forecasts. In the first six months, expect to: Establish a track record of acquiring new enterprise CP&S clients and securing initial revenue bookings. Build and sustain a healthy pipeline of new-logo opportunities sufficient to support continued bookings performance. Demonstrate consistent self-sourced opportunity creation alongside effective use of SDR and cross-functional support. Successfully navigate competitive pursuits, executive negotiations, procurement, and contracting to close business. Demonstrate the ability to move from one successful acquisition to the next, maintaining momentum without becoming involved in ongoing account management. Show measurable progress against defined new-logo and bookings targets. In the first year, expect to: Consistently deliver against new-logo acquisition and bookings expectations. Establish a repeatable, high-performing approach to originating and closing new enterprise business across Consumer Products & Services. Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified new-logo opportunities through direct prospecting, executive relationships, industry referrals, and coordinated business development. Build a reputation as a highly effective hunter and closer who can create opportunities, navigate complex enterprise buying environments, and win competitive deals. Develop a network of executive relationships and market connections across CP&S that supports continued new-client acquisition. Be recognized for your industry knowledge, commercial judgment, competitive drive, personal accountability, and ability to deliver measurable new-business results. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is required. 7–10+ years of demonstrated success in enterprise new-business development and sales, ideally within consulting, technology services, professional services, or managed services. Extensive experience selling into Consumer Products & Services organizations particularly within Retail, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Food, and Grocery segments, with a demonstrated understanding of industry dynamics, business priorities, and enterprise buying environments. A proven track record as a true new-business hunter. You have personally originated, developed, and closed enterprise clients rather than relying on inherited accounts, established relationships, or account * expansion to deliver your results. Consistent achievement or overachievement of new-logo and new-business bookings targets, with the ability to demonstrate your individual contribution to pipeline creation and closed business. Demonstrated ability to build a territory and qualified pipeline from scratch, including direct prospecting, executive networking, account penetration, and competitive displacement. Experience originating and closing complex, high-value enterprise engagements, ideally with organizations generating $2B+ in annual revenue. Proven success selling consultative, service-oriented solutions involving technology, consulting, managed services, or other complex professional services offerings. Strong understanding of the challenges facing consumer products and retail organizations including digital commerce, brand and marketing transformation, supply chain modernization, operational efficiency, customer experience, and AI-enabled business transformation. Ability to engage credibly with C-suite executives and senior business and technology leaders within CP&S organizations, develop executive sponsorship, and navigate complex stakeholder environments. Strong business acumen and the ability to uncover client challenges, shape commercial opportunities, and translate business priorities into compelling solutions. Demonstrated success leading full-cycle enterprise sales pursuits, including opportunity qualification, solution development, competitive positioning, pricing, negotiation, procurement, and contracting. Experience navigating complex enterprise procurement, legal, and commercial processes within large consumer products, retail, or services organizations. Strong understanding of emerging technologies, including AI, and the ability to discuss their practical application to enterprise business challenges within Consumer Products & Services. Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to shape and win complex engagements while retaining personal ownership of the sales outcome. Strong commercial discipline, including pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, opportunity prioritization, and consistent execution. Resilience, persistence, competitive drive, and the ability to create momentum in environments where opportunities must be earned rather than provided. An entrepreneurial mindset, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment. Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. Essential Job Functions Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera. Work independently with minimal supervision. Use all required digital collaboration tools. Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines. US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold.
